name_en: Yakitori — chicken, or sometimes pork, grilled on skewers by cut
summary_ja: 鶏肉を中心に部位ごとに串へ刺し、炭火や網で焼く料理。もも・むねなどの正肉と、せせり・すなぎも・レバーなどの内臓とでは火の入れ方も食感もまるで違う。地域によっては鶏でなく豚を串にし、それでも「やきとり」と呼ぶ土地がある。
summary_en: Chicken, mostly, cut by part and skewered over charcoal or a wire rack — prime cuts like thigh and breast take heat very differently from offal such as neck meat, gizzard, or liver. In some regions the skewers hold pork instead, yet the dish keeps the name yakitori.
source_publisher: 一般社団法人 日本焼き鳥協会
